title: Channel sticky addressee: after @Drift, un-@ follow-ups still wake Drift
description:
## Wanted product

In a channel, after Jack @mentions an agent, the **next human messages with no @ still go to that agent**, the way a group chat keeps talking to the person you just named. Other agents may chime in; they are not auto-woken on every sticky turn.

Today lp-k5c4.15: named @s only; unmentioned → lead. That made `@Drift` stop waking Alpha, but then "ok, also send that file" goes to the lead again.

## Rule

- No @ yet in the channel → lead (unchanged).
- Human @Drift (and not others) → Drift. Sticky addressee = Drift.
- Next human text with no @ → **Drift**, not lead.
- Human @Alpha or @Drift @Beta → sticky set becomes those names.
- Explicit room address (TBD: @channel / @here / talking to the lead by name) clears sticky → lead.
- Persona hops still mailbox.send; do not auto-fan the sticky human turn to the whole roster.
- Fuse + hop cap still bound agent chiming. No recursive wake of the speaker.

## Do not

- Wake the whole roster on sticky turns
- Restore "lead PLUS @s" (lp-k5c4.15 stays)
- Track sticky across 1:1s (1:1 is already that agent)

## Acceptance

- [ ] decideHuman (or a small sticky-addressee layer on the thread) implements the rule above
- [ ] Playwright #testchat: @Drift hi → Drift only; follow-up "what's the status" with no @ → Drift only; Alpha silent
- [ ] @Alpha after that → Alpha, Drift silent
- [ ] Unmentioned first message in a fresh channel still wakes lead
- [ ] Tests in wake-policy; no mention-hop
acceptance_criteria: After human @Drift, next no-@ human turns in that channel wake Drift only. New @ switches. First unmentioned still lead. Playwright #testchat. No roster fan-out. No mention-hop.
close_reason: Done. Branch beads/lp-k5c4.19-sticky-addressee merged to beads/lp-k5c4-inbound-work-spine-plan 2944c7ec. Tests: wake-policy.test.ts 19 pass, group-inbound-stamp.test.ts 21 pass (40 total). Sticky addressee thread-scoped: after @Drift, no-@ wakes Drift; new @ switches; @channel clears to lead; first unmentioned still lead; no roster fan-out.
